lines.text: Heavy things always land first. Watch.
Look at that. The paper's barely trying.
Same paper. Same book. Another race.
You can encourage it. It still won't win.
That's not a race. That's public transport.
If weight alone decides, the book should leave it behind.
No glue. No tricks. Just watch.
It kept up! You didn't make it heavier.
Air was slowing the loose sheet down.
The book shields the paper from most of that resistance.
So being light wasn't the whole explanation?
Can it give my homework a lift, too?
